translations.web: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
translations.bsb: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
translations.kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
translations.asv: He hath walled up my ways with hewn stone; he hath made my paths crooked.
